calls.title: Final feedback before website go live
calls.summary: The team discussed setting a targeted go-live date of April 23rd while managing stakeholder expectations by aiming for an earlier internal readiness by the 20th. They acknowledged a lack of a clear, tracked list of final deliverables, leading to confusion and hasty preparations ahead of the launch. The discussion emphasized increasing Kari's involvement in design decisions to ensure a polished user experience. Current homepage designs were criticized for being inconsistent and having excessive white space, with previous versions preferred for clarity. There was a need to refine messaging, distinctly separating 'release' from 'deploy' to improve understanding. Additionally, they plan to enhance onboarding visuals, with architecture diagrams deemed too complex needing redesign.
calls.keywords: Website go-live, homepage design, Managed Warehouse, feature flags, experimentation page, Bright Scout project
